description:
Reply to a mention of the account on someone else's media.

Pass comment_id to reply to the specific comment that mentioned you; omit it to leave a new top-level comment on the media instead. The media's owner must allow comments.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

comment_id.description: Comment ID to thread the reply under. Omit to comment on the media itself.

media_id.description: Media ID the mention appears on

name: instagram_reply_to_mention
title: Reply to Mention
